# AD Electrician Los Angeles 1, LLC

> Electrician serving Los, CA.

## Services
- [Wiring](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/electrician/ad-electrician-los-angeles-1-llc/services/wiring/): Electrical wiring and rewiring for renovations, additions, and repairs.
- [Panel Upgrade](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/electrician/ad-electrician-los-angeles-1-llc/services/panel/): Electrical panel upgrades, replacements, and safety improvements.
- [Lighting](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/electrician/ad-electrician-los-angeles-1-llc/services/lighting/): Interior and exterior lighting installation, repair, and upgrades.
- [Outlets & Switches](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/electrician/ad-electrician-los-angeles-1-llc/services/outlets/): Outlet and switch installation, repair, and GFCI upgrades.
- [Safety Inspection](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/electrician/ad-electrician-los-angeles-1-llc/services/inspection/): Electrical safety inspections and code correction services.
- [Emergency Electrical](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/electrician/ad-electrician-los-angeles-1-llc/services/emergency-electrician/): 24/7 emergency electrical service for urgent issues.
